name: Westbound Panama Canal "Land & Sea" Beef Tenderloin & Lobster Medallions Surf & Turf
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Westbound Panama Canal (Land and Sea Menu)
whyItWorks: Center-cut filet mignon paired with sweet poached lobster medallions is the ultimate zero-fiber, ultra-tender protein combination on the 14-night WBPC.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the beef tenderloin medium-rare to medium with plain olive oil and the lobster medallions steamed plain (drawn butter and béarnaise on the side) with baked potato or white rice.
watchOuts: Skip rich béarnaise and heavy drawn butter during flares
